text.content:
It is a time of great upheaval, but those who would usually resolve political unrest, the Jedi Order, have recently been disbanded, labeled traitors, and are being hunted down.

Chancellor Palpatine has just (or is about to) declare himself the Emperor and dissolved the Republic, into the first Galactic Empire. He says it is for “A more safe and secure galaxy.” Out of shear terror, and clinging to safety, almost all galactic politicians, including the Senate, have fallen in line and thrown their support behind Emperor Palpatine. This is an era of play perfect for players who want to be constantly hunted by Inquisitors—Dark Side users who wield red lightsabers. Together with Darth Vader, they hunt down all Jedi remnants.

Quest Starter: News of an “Order 66” has just reached you. News of an order from the newly-appointed Emperor to kill all the Jedi. The panic is spreading. One by one, lives are winking out of existence, Jedi all over the galaxy are either dead or going “no-contact” and vanishing, breaking all communication with other members of the Order in order to stay alive. A Jedi Padawan named Erktu Ma’a has sent out distress signal, her master has been killed and she’s all alone? Will you go to rescue her? How will you help her?

We are in the very middle of the Galactic Civil War, it has been raging for many years, and we have been operating in the shadows.

All the Jedi are long gone, Mon Mothma and Admiral Ackbar have pieced together fleets of rebels to try and fight against the Empire and restore the Republic. Indeed, the name of their rebel group is the “Alliance to Restore the Republic.” They need help, there are stories of rebel heroes such as Wedge Antilles, Prince Leia Organa, the rogue smuggler Han Solo now turned into a “General,” and even perhaps a Jedi Knight still working with the Rebellion? This is an era of play perfect for those who want to play during the worst times in the galaxy, when everything was cutthroat and spies were everywhere, and allegiances were constantly shifting.

Quest Starter: Intel suggests the Empire is building a new “superweapon” (this could either by the original Death Star, the Second Death Star, or something else entirely, depending on when you are playing during the Civil War). If this superweapon is complete, it could spell doom for any freedom-loving peoples. What is this superweapon? What does it do? How will you work to sabotage or steal it?

The Empire has been defeated, it is a few years AFTER the Galactic Civil War was won…or so we thought? There are rumors of a military mastermind named Grand Admiral Thrawn, who has returned from the Unknown Regions and is hellbent on rebuilding the Empire from the ashes.

The Rebels restored freedom and created the “New Republic,” but they did not have long to celebrate before it became apparent the Empire was not entirely done. Even minus an Emperor, and with Darth Vader and others dead, Imperial “warlords” emerged from where they had been hiding. Known as the “Imperial Remnant,” they’ve been mostly ineffective. The Empire is in shambles. Fighting and bickering amongst themselves proved to be self-destructive, but a clear leader finally emerged in the form of a mysterious, red-eyed, blue-skinned Chiss named Grand Admiral Thrawn, a tactical mastermind who is now threatening to undo all the good that both the Rebels and we Sabersworn were able to do. This is a time of great mystery, new threats, and a way to pave a new way for the players of the game without having to worry about stepping on the continuity of the Original Trilogy.

Quest Starter: Grand Admiral Thrawn’s ship, the Chimaera, has been spotted moving around the forest moon of Endor, and Imperial research teams have been combing the debris of the destroyed Death Star. Meanwhile, his operatives have also been seen on the forested moon of Myrkr, a place known for a strange creature called the ysalamiri, who legend says has Force-suppressing powers. Also, he’s sent ships out into the Unknown Regions, possibly to recruit (enslave?) aliens from previously uncontacted worlds. Thrawn’s machinations are many, he’s got tons of plans in motion. How are they all connected? What will you do to find out his master plan?
